svg.text: Replica watch — what each node believed, for the components you pick (DESIGN_Review_Perspective.md §6.13)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
① Details — watch a component on the timeline (the eye in its header)
the eye (right end of a component header): watch it on the timeline · teal = watched, grey = not
on every component header of a networked unit, in the merged view only
amber here is the instant view (as built); the lane below shows only what PERSISTS
③ the lane's settings (the gear on the lane)
Show a disagreement only when it lasts longer than
≈ 2 × the time-sync tolerance: normal replication catch-up stays hidden
Watch another component… (or the eye in Details)
per unit: each selected unit keeps its own watch list (empty by default ⇒ no lane)
tolerance: discrete values default to exact; a continuous one (position, heading) to a size in its unit
✕ stops watching · the threshold applies to every watched component
② the Event Timeline — one lane per selected unit, spans of PERSISTENT disagreement, one colour per watched component
Health — SimHost-1 believed 300 while the owner CGF-1 had 0
for 2.4 s (12.1 – 14.5 s) · click = seek to its start
a span = a watched component on which some node disagreed with the owner beyond its tolerance for longer than the threshold
normal replication delay and clock offset (a few frames at each change) never show · hover = who believed what · click = seek
the lane exists only in the merged view, for the selected unit, while it has a watched component
